claim_boundary: Retrospective achieved-precision and minimum-resolvable risk-difference derivation over the checksum-pinned #5351 successor rows. This is a design-sensitivity diagnostic, NOT a post-hoc observed-data adequacy computation, NOT prospective sizing, and NOT a claim that 30 seeds were adequate for any target effect. Output remains blocked_review_pending and promotes no benchmark, paper, or dissertation claim automatically.

claim_gate.reason: retrospective precision derivation over frozen #5351 rows; claim promotion requires human review

estimand.description: Paired risk difference in binary outcome rates between two planner arms on matched scenario-seed cells

exclusions.reason: The cluster bootstrap percentile interval is not validated for event rates near zero; contrasts where both arms have near-zero event rates produce degenerate intervals that cannot support precision claims
The 35 scenario families are the resampling unit, not a random sample from a super-population; precision statements apply to these specific families, not to unseen scenario types
Within-family correlation is preserved by the cluster bootstrap; treating individual cells as independent would artificially narrow intervals and overstate precision
The 30 seeds per scenario were not chosen via a prospective sizing calculation for any specific target effect; the MRRD is a retrospective design-sensitivity measure, not a prospective adequacy claim

multiplicity.note: Holm step-down correction over all exposed contrasts, matching the admitted #5351 multiplicity policy

practical_effect_rule.description: A risk difference below min_risk_difference is treated as practically null even when its interval excludes zero

proposed_dissertation_statement: [blocked_review_pending] Retrospective achieved-precision derivation over the frozen 0.0.3.post1 successor rows (n=1440 matched cells per planner pair, one-stage scenario-family cluster bootstrap with n=35 families, 95% equal-tailed percentile intervals, B=2000 resamples). Achieved collision CI widths range from 0.1663 (hybrid_rule_v3_fast_progress_static_escape_continuous vs orca) to 0.3297 (social_force vs orca). The minimum resolvable risk difference under the declared practical-effect threshold (>= 0.02) ranges from 0.1060 to 0.1800 across headline contrasts. This is a design-sensitivity measure, NOT a post-hoc observed-data adequacy computation, and does NOT claim prospective adequacy of the 30-seed design. Multiplicity: Holm step-down over 39 exposed contrasts. Material exclusions: rare-event degeneracy, family-generalization beyond the 35 observed families, and non-independent cell interpretation. Claim promotion requires separate human review.
terminology_note: This report uses 'achieved precision' (CI width) and 'minimum resolvable risk difference' (MRRD, a design-sensitivity measure). It does NOT report any post-hoc observed-data adequacy metric, does NOT claim prospective adequacy, and does NOT claim that the 30-seed design was chosen via a prospective sizing calculation.
